card.name: Positional words in layout or order
card.fires_on: Words that point to a position, direction or order, such as top, right, left, first, diagonal and face, in general web text. They sit just before the thing being placed, like "top to bottom" or "the right-hand side".

modes.label: Page and grid position
modes.description: Direction or position words describing where something sits on a page, table or diagram.
modes.example: looking up the remainder in the<< left>>most columns of the table

modes.label: Order and sequence
modes.description: Words about which item comes first or how items chain in order.

modes.label: Face-to-face phrase
modes.description: The word face in the idiom "look you in the face".
modes.example: Waiters and shop-workers looked you in the<< face>> and treated you as an equal.

card.writes: It suppresses superlative and contrast words like longest, oldest and opposite, so it seems to steer away from those after a position word.
card.plain: It lights up on words that say where something is placed or in what order, like top, left or first.
